phases.name: stability foundation
phases.focus: build knee-stabilizing control and confidence with low-impact loads

phases.name: strength development
phases.focus: progress multi-joint strength with knee-friendly ranges and tempo

phases.name: power & field prep
phases.focus: introduce controlled power and movement patterns aligned with skiing

non_negotiables: no deep knee flexion under load
surgeon clearance confirmed for strength work
progressive overload with respect to knee tolerance

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-week knee-friendly strength for skiing return"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Rebuild knee-stable strength for skiing return"
PHASES
  PHASE "stability foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY main strength training 60m "Foundation stability & low-impact strength":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
          leg_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60
          dumbbell_step_up 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          calf_stretch 2m
      DAY accessory training 40m "Stability and control":
        warmup:
          hip_circ 2m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45
          prone_plank 3x30s rpe 4 rest 30
          side_plank 3x20s per side rpe 4 rest 30
          Pallof_press 3x12 each side rpe 5 rest 45
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          glute_stretch 2m
      DAY stability 30m "Knee-friendly balance work":
        warmup:
          march_in_place 3m
        main straight_sets:
          single_leg_balance 3x30s each leg rpe 4 rest 30
          cable_internal_rotation 3x12 each side rpe 4 rest 30
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          hip_adduction_stretch 2m
      DAY conditioning 20m "Low-impact conditioning":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 2m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 6x1m on/1m off rpe 5 rest 0
        cooldown:
          gentle stretch 2m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY main strength training 60m "Progression & control":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
          leg_mdr 2m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x9 rpe 6 rest 60
          dumbbell_step_up 3x9 rpe 6 rest 60
          leg_extension (light) 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          calf_stretch 2m
      DAY accessory training 40m "Mobility & control":
        warmup:
          hip_circles 2m
        main straight_sets:
          reverse_lunge_unweighted 3x8 each leg rpe 5 rest 45
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45
          side_plank 3x25s per side rpe 4 rest 30
        cooldown:
          thoracic_spine_tilt 2m
      DAY stability 30m "Dynamic stability":
        warmup:
          marching 3m
        main straight_sets:
          single_leg Romanian_deadlift (light) 3x8 each leg rpe 5 rest 60
          pallof_press 3x12 each side rpe 5 rest 45
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY conditioning 20m "Low-impact cardio":
        warmup:
          walk 2m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 6x40s on/20s off rpe 5
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
  PHASE "strength development" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY main strength training 70m "Multi-joint strength with knee tolerance":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
          activation: glute_bridge_hold 2x15s
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_back_squat (brace, shallow ROM) 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90
          seated_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 60
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          hip_adductor_stretch 2m
      DAY accessory training 40m "Limb symmetry & control":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60
          cable_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY stability 30m "Knee-friendly tempo work":
        warmup:
          toe_to_bar 2m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat (bodyweight to light load) 3x8 each leg rpe 5 rest 60
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY conditioning 20m "Low-impact conditioning":
        warmup:
          march_in_place 2m
        main straight_sets:
          rower 8x30s on/60s off rpe 5
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY main strength training 70m "Volume & control":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
          activation: clamshells 2x15s
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90
          hack_squat 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 60
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY accessory training 40m "Mobility & stability":
        warmup:
          thoracic_mop 2m
        main straight_sets:
          cable_fly 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45
          goblet_split_squat 3x8 each leg rpe 6 rest 60
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45
          Pallof_press 3x12 each side rpe 5 rest 45
        cooldown:
          figure_four_stretch 2m
      DAY stability 30m "Controlled gait & balance":
        warmup:
          marching 3m
        main straight_sets:
          single_leg_balance 3x40s each leg rpe 4 rest 30
          medio pullap 3x12 each side rpe 5 rest 45
        cooldown:
          IT_band_stretch 2m
      DAY conditioning 20m "Rowing base work":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 2m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 6x1m on/1m off rpe 5
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 2m
  PHASE "power & field prep" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY main strength training 75m "Power-oriented with knee care":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
          explosive_mly 2m
        main straight_sets:
          push_press (light) 3x5 rpe 7 rest 90
          deadlift (light) 3x5 rpe 7 rest 90
          incline_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90
          bent_over_row 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY accessory training 40m "Stability and control":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          overhead_tricep_extension 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45
          external_rotation 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45
          ab_wheel 3x8 rpe 5 rest 45
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY stability 30m "Dynamic balance drills":
        warmup:
          march_in_place 2m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_toehold 3x30s rpe 4 rest 30
          single_leg RDL (light) 3x8 each leg rpe 5 rest 60
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY conditioning 20m "Low-impact conditioning":
        warmup:
          walk 2m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 6x45s on/45s off rpe 5
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY main strength training 75m "Strength-matched power tempo":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat_to_catch (pauses) 3x5 rpe 7 rest 90
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x5 rpe 7 rest 90
          dumbbell_press 3x6 rpe 7 rest 90
          cable_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY accessory training 40m "Mobility + trunk":
        warmup:
          thoracic_mop 2m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10 rpe 5 rest 45
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2m
      DAY stability 30m "Proprioception":
        warmup:
          marching 2m
        main straight_sets:
          single_leg_balance 3x40s each leg rpe 4 rest 30
          pallof_press 3x12 each side rpe 5 rest 45
        cooldown:
          hip_adduction_stretch 2m
      DAY conditioning 20m "Rowing intervals":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 2m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 8x30s on/60s off rpe 5
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 2m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY main strength training 75m "Peak strength with knee safety":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
          activation: glute_bridge 2x15s
        main straight_sets:
          back_squat (low ROM, controlled) 4x4 rpe 8 rest 120
          Romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 90
          barbell_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 60
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY accessory training 40m "Upper/lower balance":
        warmup:
          scapular_retraction 2m
        main straight_sets:
          cable_fly 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60
          reverse_hyperext 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY stability 30m "Proprioception mix":
        warmup:
          march_in_place 2m
        main straight_sets:
          single_leg Romanian_deadlift (light) 3x6 each leg rpe 5 rest 60
          Pallof_press 3x12 each side rpe 5 rest 45
        cooldown:
          IT_band_stretch 2m
      DAY conditioning 20m "Rowing steady state":
        warmup:
          walk 2m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 20m continuous rpe 5
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 2m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY main strength training 75m "Taper into skiing readiness":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
          activation: glute_bridge 2x15s
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat (light) 3x5 rpe 6 rest 90
          deadlift (light) 3x5 rpe 6 rest 90
          incline_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 60
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY accessory training 40m "Movement quality":
        warmup:
          thoracic_mop 2m
        main straight_sets:
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45
          ab_wheel 3x8 rpe 5 rest 45
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY stability 30m "Tuning proprioception":
        warmup:
          marching 2m
        main straight_sets:
          balance pad steps 3x30s each leg rpe 4 rest 30
          Pallof_press 3x12 each side rpe 5 rest 45
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2m
      DAY conditioning 20m "Skiing prep cardio":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 2m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 6x45s on/45s off rpe 5
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2m
